text: Mark Litman It's not true. This is a special שב”ן package for pregnancy, not the standard entitlement that residents get under the HMO. Subject to some rare exceptions, partners with A5 visas get access to all the standard pregnancy (and other health) benefits as soon as they get their A5 visa, without any waiting period. There is usually a waiting period for שב”ן packages (to stop people just buying them, having one procedure and then cancelling)
